findings.text: blocking: The automatic path clears pending state in reckon/crew_run_commands.py:4043 before finish_landing commits and pushes the section declaration; a refused beat only adds landing_beat_refusal and returns accepted, and a crash in this interval leaves no retry record or live pointer, so the code can land while the section stays implementable indefinitely; retaining the pending record alone is insufficient because pending_landing.py:477 calls _settled_landing, which clears already-integrated records before finish_landing can run.

non-blocking: Given line 359 already asserts PLAN is absent, dict.get returns the test's own literal zero and this assertion cannot fail for any result that reaches it; it adds no regression protection and should not be counted as coverage of weekly landing totals.
